ambient: A stage of the vaulting completes and the next one begins.
Your place stays exactly where it is.
description: It is enormous, it is made of the same folding that made everything else, and it has been running for ten thousand years with nobody required to attend. You have a place in here. It was assigned a long time ago, it has been kept for you, and it is going to be kept after you leave.
name: The Cathedral

looks: It goes up in stages, and each stage is a longer time than the one below it.
None of it is stone. All of it is holding.
You can see how it was built, which was by continuing.
objects.name: the vaulting

looks: Marked, kept, and the right size.
You have used it before, at length, and did not know that until now.
Nobody is going to sit in it while you are away.
objects.name: your place in it

weather: The air here is old and moves the way air moves in a very large building.
